fieldNotes.truckGate: Open campus. No barrier arm, sliding/swing gate, or checkpoint pinch-point at any entry. Truck driveways run unobstructed off the shared industrial-park access road (Apollo Dr area) directly onto the truck pavement.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth at any entrance. Only a UNFI directional sign at the access-road junction.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock doors run along both the SW/west building face and the east building face — two distinct dock banks consistent with separate shipping and receiving clusters.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Diagonal trailer-parking stalls on the far east edge of the property plus a trailer block at the SW corner; many trailers parked without tractors.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Wide paved truck yards on both the west and east faces provide interior queueing room ahead of the docks.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town Champaign industrial park; the property abuts open farm fields to the west and south. Judged Rural per the small-town-industrial tie-break rule, though it sits in a metro of ~230k.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Truck driveways are uncontrolled, so 'lanes' are nominal single-lane drive widths; not separately marked.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Main long warehouse plus an attached/adjacent front office structure counted as 2.

citations.claim: UNFI's FY2025 Form 10-K, Item 2 Properties, lists a distribution centre at "Champaign, Illinois" as of 2025-08-02. Our roster address for this record is "3001 Apollo Dr, Champaign, IL 61820".

divestitureCheck.method: Checked against UNFI's FY2025 10-K property table and against its publicly announced 2025-2026 network consolidation. UNFI has closed 12 distribution centres in six years, so presence on the 10-K list alone is not treated as proof of current operation; the announced closures were checked by name.
divestitureCheck.result: present on the FY2025 property list and not named in any announced closure

sources.covers: UNFI network optimisation, the Allentown PA closure, and Central-region consolidations

verification.claimScope: CITY-LEVEL identity only. The 10-K names the city, not the parcel. This record is `probable` rather than `confirmed` because no retrieved source ties UNFI to the specific parcel traced here.
verification.rationale: PROBABLE: UNFI's own SEC 10-K property table lists a distribution centre in Champaign, Illinois as of 2025-08-02, and this record sits in that city. That establishes the company operates a DC there. It does NOT establish that the parcel traced here is that DC, and no source retrieved in this pass closes that gap, so the verdict stops at probable.
